snippet.title: Death of a Dungslinger - Trailer (2025 Boss Rush Game Jam)
snippet.description:
Made in 30 days for the 2025 Boss Rush Game Jam
As a beetle, you can pick up material from the ground and roll it into a ball. Ball up some crud and hop on! You can fire with a power meter- careful not too overshoot the green zone. Nail perfect hits across more than 4 levels of boss beetle battles. Can you earn a future lifetime by blindly obeying orders in this one?
